name: Regina
description: The administrative heart of the subsector. A temperate world of grey oceans and crowded coastal arcologies, Regina runs on paperwork, tariffs and the quiet assumption that everyone is on someone's payroll. The Highport never sleeps and the Downport never quite gets clean.
traits: Star Port A; Planet; Medium Gravity
notes: Port Admiral Cassia Vane is skimming from the berthing fees and laundering it through a shipping cooperative. If the party digs into any docking irregularity, she will notice within a week.

name: Lanth
description: A cold, thin-aired world held together by an Imperial naval presence and the money that follows it. Outside the base perimeter the settlements are company towns: mining consortium housing, consortium stores, consortium security.
traits: Star Port B; Planet; Low Gravity; Polluted
notes: The naval base commander knows the mining consortium is using indentured labour and has chosen not to file the report. He can be leveraged, but not cheaply.
hooks: [{"title":"Off the Books","description":"A consortium shift supervisor wants forty of her people moved offworld without appearing on any manifest. She can pay in refined ore.","used":false}]
timeline_history: [{"date":"1101-06-12","event":"Imperial Navy established a permanent refuelling station in orbit.","visibility":"public"}]

name: Dinomn
description: A sunless rogue world drifting between stars, claimed by nobody and surveyed by almost nobody. The single settlement is a hollowed-out research station running on a fusion plant that predates the current owners.
traits: Rouge Planet; No Star Port; Low Gravity; Unexplored; Amber Zone
notes: The fusion plant is Ancient technology, not human-built. The current residents do not know this. At least two survey corporations do.
